tools.name: get_wall_info
tools.description: Rules, prices, size, minimum order, payment networks, terms version and whether purchases are open. Numbers come from the live settings. No input.

tools.name: wall_overview
tools.description: Current wall version, the URL of the full-wall PNG (1 pixel = 1 cell; alpha 0 empty, 255 bought, 254 site-owned house art) and how to read regions. Wraps GET /api/wall. No input.

tools.name: read_region
tools.description: Pixels and owners of a rectangle (w*h <= 10000). format "json" (default): base64 RGBA pixels plus runs of empty / buyer (with public display name) / house cells. format "png": the rectangle as a PNG image. tools.name: check_cells_available
tools.description: Price a selection of cells right now and say whether it can be ordered (meets the minimum, not reserved, not in image review). Nothing is reserved or charged. Wraps POST /api/quote. Wall coordinates: x 0..999 (left to right), y 0..999 (top to bottom); cell index = y*1000 + x.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order for cells and return the USDC payment details (recipient wallet, token, amount_units, Solana reference, pay_by, status URL). tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order and its USDC payment (state, received, remaining, confirmations, refunds). Wraps GET /api/order/{id}. status: pending, processing, paid, pending_review, expired, cancelled, late_paid, refund_pending, refunded, failed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wall_overview, check_cells_available · Private data: create_order · Public sink: check_cells_available · Destructive: read_region.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wall_overview, check_cells_available · Private data: create_order · Public sink: check_cells_available · Destructive: read_region

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
